pain_points.quote: Anchor the foundations, develop strengths, integrate durably.
pain_points.desc_1: In many sports journeys, technique is worked on, but what makes a child persevere in the long run is left out:
pain_points.desc_bold_1: confidence, emotion management, concentration, and the ability to bounce back after a mistake.
pain_points.desc_2: When these foundations are not built, the child may progress for a while, then stagnate, tense up, or lose their enjoyment. Thrive helps young athletes develop a deeper transformation:
pain_points.desc_bold_2: mental and technical skills that set in over time.
pain_points.list_1: They learn to better manage pressure and mistakes, in training as well as in matches.
pain_points.list_2: They develop mental reflexes useful at school, in sports, and during daily moments of tension.
pain_points.list_3: They gain stability, autonomy, and confidence, with skills that last beyond the season.
pain_points.list_4: They build concrete tools that also help them in their daily life, not just on the field.
pain_points.conclusion: Thrive does not just seek to improve performance. We build lasting foundations so your child moves forward with more solidity, clarity, and enjoyment, now and for the future.

process.title: Our 3-Step Method
process.subtitle: A structured process to transform potential into real performance.
process.step1_d: Establish trust, measure the baseline, and lay the foundations for mental skills. The child learns to know themselves as an athlete.
process.step2_d: Teach and practice the 6 interventions. The child experiments, fails, readjusts, and progresses in a safe environment.
process.step3_d: Consolidate skills, measure final progress, and prepare for autonomy. The child uses their tools alone — on the ice and in life.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: My child is a beginner, is this for them?
faq.a1: Absolutely. Thrive is ideal for building technical foundations and confidence from the start, avoiding bad habits.
faq.q2: Where do the sessions take place?
faq.a2: As close to you as possible, in arenas or open training locations.
faq.q3: Do parents need to be present?
faq.a3: For ages 2-5, yes. For older children, we encourage you to attend the last 5 minutes for the end-of-session review.
faq.a4: Although our mentors are trained in psychology, the service is billed as sports tutoring. Check with your insurance provider under the 'Physical activity' or 'Well-being' category.

sports.page_subtitle: 5 disciplines, one philosophy: Performance through human development.
sports.summary_desc: Regardless of the discipline, we apply the same scientific rigor to develop the complete athlete.

patinage.name: Skating
patinage.tech_4: Transition to Hockey or Figure Skating
patinage.perma_desc: Skating is the foundation. Mastering the glide creates immediate self-efficacy, reducing the fear of falling to reach the state of Flow.

hockey.name: Hockey
hockey.perma_desc: Hockey requires constant information intake. We practice Mindfulness so the child stays clear-headed under pressure.

basket.name: Basketball
basket.perma_desc: Basketball is a game of failure (missing a shot is normal). We cultivate a 'Growth Mindset': seeing every missed shot as adjustment data, not a fault.

soccer.name: Soccer
soccer.perma_desc: Soccer is the ultimate team sport. We connect individual technique to relational intelligence: anticipating a teammate's needs.

football.name: Football
football.perma_desc: A high-intensity sport. We learn to channel adrenaline into positive energy (Excitement) rather than stress, building courage and determination.

method.intro_desc: Developed by Dr. Martin Seligman, the father of positive psychology, this model is our compass. We don't guess how to motivate your child; we apply a validated science.

perma.p_d: Pleasure releases dopamine, accelerating motor learning. A happy child learns 3x faster than an anxious child.
perma.e_d: We structure challenges to reach the state of "Flow", where concentration is total and time disappears.
perma.r_d: The mentor-athlete bond is the foundation of emotional security. Knowing they are unconditionally supported frees the child from the fear of making mistakes.
perma.m_d: Every exercise has a "why". We connect effort to the child's values (mutual aid, courage) to give meaning to fatigue.
perma.a_d: Confidence is not given; it is built through victories. We create "micro-successes" in every session to build self-efficacy.

science.title: The Measurable Impact of Happiness
science.stat1_d: Studies show that positive brains are 31% more productive and accurate than negative or stressed brains.
science.stat2_d: Positive emotions broaden the attentional field, allowing one to see more play solutions (Broaden-and-Build Theory).
science.stat3_d: The caring approach reduces cortisol (stress hormone), promoting faster physical and mental recovery.

scorecard.title: The THRIVE Scorecard
scorecard.subtitle: The Engineering of Transformation: Transforming the intangible into a measurable asset.
scorecard.val_text1: All these measurements are made using
scorecard.val_text2: validated by international psychology committees. These are real diagnostic tools, not just observations.
scorecard.s1_desc: A physiological analysis at each session to adapt the intensity. We don't force learning on a tired nervous system.
scorecard.s1_b1_d: Measures "Readiness". A low HRV signals invisible fatigue; we adapt the session to protect self-esteem.
scorecard.s1_b2_d: Evaluation of sleep, mood, and global stress (school, family, sports). The child is taken into account as a whole.
scorecard.s1_b3_d: Detects mental blocks: if perceived effort is 9/10 for a simple exercise, we intervene immediately.
scorecard.s2_desc: Tangible proof of the change in sports personality. We measure the transition from "avoidance" to "proactivity".
scorecard.s2_b1_d: Measures the 4Cs: Confidence, Control, Challenge, Commitment. We bring the child out of the shadows.
scorecard.s2_b2_d: The measurement of "Flourishing". Scientific validation that the child is happy, engaged, and accomplished.
scorecard.s2_b3_d: Changes the narrative: we no longer talk about what needs fixing, but about their powerful "signature strengths".
scorecard.s3_desc: Proving that internal values translate into external actions on the ice.
scorecard.s3_b1_d: Proves that the child now plays for themselves (intrinsic) and not out of fear of disappointing.
scorecard.s3_b2_d: Surgical measurement of confidence in a technical gesture. Confidence is no longer blurry; it becomes a certainty.
scorecard.s3_b3_d: The "Gold Standard". Observation of concrete behaviors (e.g., encouraging a teammate after a mistake).

dashboard.title: The Elite Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Strategic Visualization to maximize value. A report worthy of a high-end consultant, not just an instructor.
dashboard.b1_desc: Spider web chart overlaying Session 1 (Baseline) and Session 6.
dashboard.b2_li1: Encouraged their goalie after a conceded goal (Leadership)
dashboard.b2_li2: Requested an extra rep on their own initiative (Engagement)
dashboard.b2_li3: Kept their calm after two consecutive failures (Emotional Control)
dashboard.b3_desc: Line graph showing the drop in cortisol and HRV regulation over the weeks. Proof of stress management.
dashboard.b4_desc: Visual badge of the 5 dominant strengths.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Direct, jargon-free answers to help you choose with confidence.
faq.q1_q: What's the difference between the packs?
faq.q1_a: Every pack includes the full THRIVE method and the 13 coached sessions. What changes is the depth of tracking: how often you get detailed reports (none, 3, or all 13), how fine the measurements are (overall score, per-skill detail, LSSS curve) and the exclusives (direct messaging, exports). The higher the pack, the more concrete proof and coach closeness you get.
faq.q2_q: Does my child need to have a problem to start?
faq.q2_a: No. Most children supported by THRIVE don't have a diagnosed "problem". They simply need a different environment — a space to build confidence, focus, and emotional regulation without pressure.
faq.q3_a: No. Each pack is a one-time investment covering the full 13-session journey. No recurring payment, no surprises.
faq.q4_q: Why does Advanced cost more than Essential?
faq.q4_a: Because it adds the measurement layer: detailed reports with scored observations at the milestone sessions (3 · 7 · 13), per-skill gauge, scientific LSSS curve and a personalized letter from the coach. You're not paying for more sessions — you're paying for more depth, proof and clarity.
faq.q5_q: Is THRIVE coaching clinical or therapeutic?
faq.q5_a: No. THRIVE is not therapy and not a clinical service. It's a sport positive psychology coaching program, based on the PERMA method and validated psychometric tools. The mentor is not a psychologist or member of the OPQ.
faq.q6_q: How do I choose the right pack?
faq.q6_a: If you want the full program and the human bond: Essential. If you want to measure and track results at the key milestones: Advanced. If you want maximum tracking, data and direct coach access: Performance.
faq.q7_a: Yes, anytime. Upgrading applies immediately for the whole family: reports you've already received are regenerated at your new pack's depth, and the new features unlock right away.
